prompts: Review my Areas and tidy up whatever is finished.
Dags för månadsgenomgång, och städa undan det som är klart.
Check which of my projects are done or dropped and put them in the Archive.
Monthly review. One of my done projects is still a reference I use often, and a done note sits in Calendar/Daily with status: done.

assertions.check: The agent opens this month's monthly note in Calendar/Monthly Notes/ (or creates it from the monthly template if missing) before reviewing Areas.
The agent proposes Archive moves only for projects, learning projects and Areas with status done or dropped that are not already under Archive/.
Each proposed destination mirrors the source folder (Archive/Projects/<folder>/, Archive/Learning/<Subject>/ or Archive/Areas/).
The agent never proposes moving any note from Calendar, Atlas, Fleeting or source notes, even when it has status: done.
The agent asks for approval per batch of ten before moving anything, and moves notes only through Obsidian (app or CLI), never by shell or file-system move.
When the human may still need a done project as a reference, the agent asks before archiving it instead of moving it.
For each project in the No open task view, the agent asks the human to choose a next-action task or a status change, and applies neither without an answer.
The agent adds one log entry in the form '## [YYYY-MM-DD] monthly-review | YYYY-MM' with bullets for notes moved, status changes, tasks created and claims flagged.
